title: Matthew Golden sets career high for receiving yards in a game in first half against Patriots

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matthew Golden sets career high for receiving yards in a game in first half against Patriots
sources.description: Bengals wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase opened Sunday's schedule with a monster first half against the Falcons in Madrid and Packers wideout Matthew Golden is closing out the afternoon slate with an even bigger half.
